title: Engine command error
description: The single JSON line `Archer --open` or `Archer --new` writes to stderr before exiting with a non-zero code. The hub shows a screen per `error` kind and the `message` only as detail.

version.description: Version of this line's format. Readers treat versions they do not know as `internal`.

error.description: What went wrong. not_found: the folder does not exist. not_a_project: the folder has no readable project.json. not_empty: --new was given a folder that has files. unknown_template: --new named a template this version does not ship. schema_too_new: the project needs a newer engine (see `schema`). schema_too_old: the project is older than this engine can migrate (see `schema`). already_open: another editor has the project open. io: the disk refused a read or write. internal: anything else (a bug).

message.description: English explanation for logs and the detail line; never parsed.

schema.description: The project's schema version. Present with schema_too_new and schema_too_old.
